text:
Alice W.: Hey team — proposing a safer rollout for runtime overrides (quotas & routing) that adds a stagger + grace window + telemetry checks. TL;DR: 1) 1% of traffic for 30m, 2) 5% for 1h if no regression, 3) 25% then 100% with auto-rollback on error-rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 200ms.

Charu P.: @Alice W. fine but how do we avoid double-billing when quota is reduced mid-rollout? Need atomicity.

Ben K.: We can apply quota delta in control plane, then switch routing. Sequence: write config -> drain existing KV caches -> swap. Might require brief 100-200ms blurred window.

Dmitri S.: Also need dashboard warns. If telemetry lags we need canary detectors to be conservative. I'd prefer a 1.5x safety multiplier on thresholds for first 2 stages.

deploy-bot: rollout started by Alice W. policy id r-83db at 1767832104

Eva L.: Example policy (draft):
```json
{
  "policy_id": "r-83db",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "duration_min": 30, "slo_checks": {"error_rate": 0.005, "p95_latency_ms": 200}},
    {"pct": 5, "duration_min": 60, "slo_checks": {"error_rate": 0.005, "p95_latency_ms": 200}},
    {"pct": 25, "duration_min": 30, "slo_checks": {"error_rate": 0.005, "p95_latency_ms": 200}}
  ],
  "finalize_pct": 100,
  "auto_rollback": true,
  "grace_window_sec": 120
}
```

Ben K.: ok, small ask — expose `grace_window_sec` in UI and API (readonly once started), show expected billing delta in console.

Charu P.: We'll need a migration plan for older agents that don't support staged routing. Fallback should be "apply to all" or block.

Alice W.: Agree. Plan: write doc + UX mock + telemetry queries. I'll open a PR with the policy schema and a lightweight console mock. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/rollout/r-83db

Dmitri S.: :thumbsup: If you can add a synthetic traffic run (10qps) step before stage 1 that would catch obvious regressions.

Alice W.: Adding synth run. Thanks all — will push PR today.
